name: Chrome Scorpion
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot —; Price 5,400 gp; Weight 2 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Upon command, this tiny mechanized scorpion animates and seeks out a single individual to sting, as designated by its owner at the time of activation. The scorpion has the statistics of a greensting scorpion but has the construct type and construct immunities, and its metal construction grants it hardness 10. After striking its target, the chrome scorpion crawls off and attempts to return to its owner as quickly as possible. The chrome scorpion can be animated for a total of 1 hour per day, though this duration may be expended in 10-minute increments.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells summon monster I; Cost 2,700 gp
